name: @ryanmazzolini/pi-skills
description: Opinionated pi skills — planning, git workflows, code review, and dev conventions

scripts.test: npm run validate:skills && npm run typecheck:extensions && node --test
scripts.eval:skills: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd evals/skills && exec baml run RunEval -- "$@"' sh
scripts.eval:skills:check: cd evals/skills && baml check && baml test -i 'contracts::*'
scripts.eval:skills:test: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'if [ -t 2 ] && [ "${TERM:-}" != dumb ]; then export SKILL_EVAL_SPINNER=1; fi; cd evals/skills && baml test -i "research::*"; status=$?; if [ "${SKILL_EVAL_SPINNER:-}" = 1 ]; then printf "\033[?25h" >&2; fi; exit $status'
